name: Perplexica
tagline: Open-source AI answer engine and search assistant with citations
description:
An open-source, self-hosted AI search engine alternative to Perplexity. Connects to SearXNG and local or cloud LLMs to fetch real-time web results, synthesize answers, and cite sources in clean markdown cards.

Vibecoded with Cursor and Claude to build a local-first conversational research assistant that respects user privacy.

replaces.note: Conversational search with real-time web citations without a $20/month Perplexity Pro subscription.
